draft.hook_en: Another ankle injury in the Bundesliga. Here's what the comeback looks like.
drills_to_film: Standing calf raises, double → single leg

all_phases.name: Phase 1 · Protect & move (days 1–7)
drills: Weight-bearing as tolerated, seated calf raises

drills: Standing calf raises, double → single leg

draft.content_angle: Most ankle sprains come back because balance training gets skipped: show the 3 balance drills every footballer should do.
draft.red_flags: Inability to take 4 steps, bone tenderness or a syndesmosis (high ankle) sprain means imaging and a longer timeline.
draft.caption_en:
Another ankle injury in the Bundesliga. Here's what the comeback looks like.

Most ankle rehab has 3 stages. This is the stage that gets rushed:
Phase 2 · Strength & balance (weeks 2–4)
1. Band eversion/inversion, 3×15
2. Single-leg balance, eyes open → closed
3. Standing calf raises, double → single leg

⚠️ General training education, not medical advice. If you're injured, see a physio first.

draft.hook_en: Another hamstring injury in the Ligue 1. Here's what the comeback looks like.
drills_to_film: Sliding leg curls on a towel or slider

all_phases.name: Phase 1 · Protect & activate (days 1–7)
drills: Gentle hip hinge with no load
Walking at normal pace, no running

all_phases.name: Phase 2 · Rebuild strength & length (weeks 2–4)
drills: Sliding leg curls on a towel or slider

all_phases.name: Phase 3 · Return to sprinting (weeks 4+)
drills: Deceleration and change-of-direction drills at full speed

draft.content_angle: Why hamstrings tear at sprint speed, and why Nordic curls are the single most proven prevention drill.
draft.red_flags: A pop felt at the moment of injury, large bruising or inability to walk means imaging first; recurrence risk is highest when players return too early.
draft.caption_en:
Another hamstring injury in the Ligue 1. Here's what the comeback looks like.

Most hamstring rehab has 3 stages. This is the stage that gets rushed:
Phase 2 · Rebuild strength & length (weeks 2–4)
1. Single-leg Romanian deadlift (bodyweight → light load)
2. Nordic hamstring curl, eccentric only, 3×4–6
3. Sliding leg curls on a towel or slider

⚠️ General training education, not medical advice. If you're injured, see a physio first.
